description: A stereo mixer with sixteen channels, a sidechain that ducks them, a compressor across the mix and a saturating output stage

params.text: Sets that channel's level, silence to twice
Places that channel across the stereo pair, hard left to hard right
Sets the level of the sidechain into the duck detector, silence to twice; it also carries the sidechain into the mix
Sets how far the sidechain pushes the mix down while it is loud, none at one end of the travel to the full amount at the other
Attenuverts the duck CV before it is added to the duck knob
Sets how hard the mix is compressed toward a steady level, none at one end of the travel to the full amount at the other
Attenuverts the press CV before it is added to the press knob
Sets the level of both outputs, silence to twice
Attenuverts the master volume CV before it is added to the master volume slider
Drives the mix into the output saturator, 0 to 11 with a cubed curve, so most of the travel is gentle and the top is not
Attenuverts the feedback CV before it is added to the feedback knob
Silences that channel on each press and restores it on the next, fading over the time set on the menu; shift-clicking solos that channel, and shift-clicking a soloed channel unsolos the lot
Silences the sidechain on each press and restores it on the next; a menu item sets whether a silenced sidechain goes on driving the ducking

inputs.text: The left side of that channel; with only the right jack patched, that one feeds both sides
The right side of that channel; with only the left jack patched, that one feeds both sides
Scales that channel's level, 0-10V for silence up to twice, on top of its slider
Scales the sidechain's level, 0-10V for silence up to twice, on top of its slider
Moves that channel across the stereo pair, added to that channel's pan knob at a fifth of the width per volt
The left side of the sidechain, which drives the ducking and is mixed in at the sidechain level
The right side of the sidechain, which drives the ducking and is mixed in at the sidechain level
Changes how far the sidechain pushes the mix down, scaled by a fifth and added to the duck knob through its attenuverter
Changes the compression, added to the press knob through its attenuverter and clamped to the knob's travel
Changes the output drive, added to the feedback knob through its attenuverter
Changes the output level, scaled by a tenth and added to the master volume slider through its attenuverter
Any voltage above 0V silences that channel, or, with the menu set to toggle, each rise flips it between silent and sounding

outputs.text: The left side of the mix, compressed, saturated and scaled by the master volume
The right side of the mix, compressed, saturated and scaled by the master volume

notes: the first jack of each row takes a polyphonic cable and spreads its channels across the strips to the right that have no cable of their own, on audio, VCA, pan and mute rows alike
menu: Apply Filters — puts a high-pass filter across the mix, which removes the offset a lopsided signal leaves behind
Muted Sidechain still Ducks — keeps the sidechain driving the ducking while its mute is on, so it shapes the mix without being heard
Enable Supersampling — runs the output stage at eight times the rate and filters it back down, which reduces the aliasing the saturator produces
Mute CVs function as Toggle — makes each rise at a mute jack flip that channel between silent and sounding, instead of the jack's level holding the mute
Mute Fade Time (ms) — a slider from 1 to 4000ms setting how long a mute takes to fade in or out
